name: Animals - hard (AI-written, not yet reviewed)
description: 39 questions on animals (21 hard, 16 medium, 2 easy), written by Claude as an add-on to the easier 'Animals' review pack (which has almost no hard ones); written as hard questions, and the fact-check pass moved the ones most adults would know down a level. A second writing pass on 2026-10-05 added 18 questions written to be quiz-night hard; an independent fact-check re-fetched every cited page, kept 15 of them as hard and moved the ones most adults would know to medium. Every question and answer needs checking by a person before anybody plays it.

source.name: Written by hand by Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) on 2026-10-05, from its own knowledge plus the pages each item cites: no API call. Every cited page was fetched on 2026-10-05 by a script that confirmed it loads and that its text contains the answer or the key words named in the item's source note (a check that the page is about the fact, not a full fact-check). Items resting on no page say "common knowledge" and why. Then fact-checked item by item by a second Claude pass on 2026-10-05 (every cited page re-fetched and read for the fact; `checked` keeps who checked it and what was fixed; items that could not be made right, and near-duplicates of other packs, were deleted). A person still reviews it by playing.

review.how: Check every question, answer and explanation. Fix or delete what is wrong, set status to 'reviewed' with your name and the date, then move the file to packs/ and list it in pack_library.js.
